## Migration states

| State | Embedded source | Legal integration modes | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `embedded` | yes | `workspace_path` | Source lives in this repository and no extraction work has started. |
| `preparing` | yes | `workspace_path` | Extraction is being prepared. Source remains a workspace member and may stay a workspace path while isolation proof is red. |
| `extracting` | yes | `workspace_path`, `exact_git_bridge` | History and source are being transferred. A temporary exact Git bridge is permitted alongside the workspace path. |
| `externalizing` | no | `exact_git_bridge`, `released_registry` | Source ownership has moved out. Consumption is an immutable exact Git bridge or a released version; the bridge requires an owner and exit condition. |
| `external` | no | `released_registry`, `exact_git_bridge` | The repository owns its source independently and is consumed as an immutable dependency. Embedded workspace source is not permitted. |
| `retired` | no | `none`, `repository_local_only` | No longer consumed by this repository. |

### `perl-parser-pest`

Experimental/learning/differential Pest parser. Maintainer ruling: becomes its own public repository; it is not the production parser. Still a workspace member, so the state is preparing, not external.

_No package currently lives here._

### `tree-sitter-perl-c`

Historical/experimental generated C Tree-sitter subject. Externalization follows the current-upstream comparison cutover; the swarm stops vendoring the C parser implementation.

_No package currently lives here._

### `lsp-framework`

Language-neutral custom LSP framework, currently embedded in perl-lsp-rs/perl-lsp-rs-core. No package has been carved out yet, and the published name is undecided: `effortless-lsp` is a working identity only. The framework must reach zero perl-* dependencies before extraction.

_No package currently lives here._

### `perl-parser`

Future native parser/compiler-front-end workspace. Preparation only: the physical split waits on the facade, incremental, position, and fact-authority gates. Package membership is frozen by #7400. Its first slice (#14259) accepted the nine front-end packages whose normal in-workspace dependency closure is already free of product-owned crates. The remaining parser-side rows stay placement-pending. This row's blocking_prerequisites and authority_refs carry the repository-level gates only. The per-package exits - parser-core utility baggage, the perl-symbol reduction, the Tree-sitter semantic overlay, the shared fact vocabulary - are held by #7400, which every pending row names as its migration_owner; they are deliberately not restated here, and the pending rows still carry #7400's generic seeded question rather than their individual exit, which #7400 owns refining.

_No package currently lives here._

### `perl-corpus`

Reusable Perl corpus assets, schemas, generators, and tooling. Must not own production parser implementation; parser execution stays an adapter.

_No package currently lives here._

### `source-identity-lower`

#7652 selected `perl-source-identity` as the canonical lower source-identity owner and landed source_identity.v1. The repository destination is still unresolved: #7663 owns proving the package builds and is consumed outside this workspace before any target is chosen.
